subject.title: refactor: finish retained plugin SDK demotions

question: Should the five retained SDK subpaths remain public until the identified external plugins have migrated and released, or is this intentionally approved as a breaking compatibility change?
rationale: Removing shipped plugin SDK exports changes the resolution contract for independently installed plugins, and no maintainer-visible approval or released migration evidence establishes that the break is accepted.

options.title: Preserve exports and migrate consumers
options.body: Keep the public export-map entries, migrate and release every known external consumer, then repeat packed-package upgrade proof before a later demotion.

options.title: Approve an intentional breaking removal
options.body: Accept the external-plugin break only with explicit maintainer ownership, release communication, and a documented upgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve exports and migrate consumers
recommendation.body: Keep the public export-map entries, migrate and release every known external consumer, then repeat packed-package upgrade proof before a later demotion.

likelyOwner.reason: This compatibility-sweep history and the current retained-demotion proposal are both connected to this area of the current codebase.
